summary.text: Caroline Bright is a Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Franklin-1 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the August 11 Democratic primary.
She is co-director of Green Mountain Girls State and has run for the legislature before.

paragraphs.text: Bright earned a bachelor's degree from Saint Michael's College in 2012, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as co-director of Green Mountain Girls State.
She ran as a Democrat for the Vermont State Senate in the Franklin District in 2012, when she was unopposed in the August 28 primary and was defeated in the general election.

In 2016 Bright was unopposed in the Democratic primary for the Franklin-1 District seat in the Vermont House of Representatives and lost the general election to Carl Rosenquist, who received 63.86 percent of the vote to her 36.14 percent.
